entryFields: insightDep (2026 no of insight submissions = like-for-like dep count)
nb: NB platform rate card, integer, EXCLUDES USA state uplift -> final NB pitch = round(nb*(1+stateUplift), nearest 100); 0 = no NB rate card for this guide
inf: insight factor -> NB insight price = volCurve(dep)*1.05*inf*1.04*1.05, round nearest 100
an: practice analytics rate card (0 = not eligible)
iren: insight renewal like-for-like price (pitch = rep = manager; MAX = *1.2); 0 = no 2026 insight -> price as NB
ren: platform renewal block or null (null = no 2026 platform -> NEW BUSINESS, use nb)
renBlock: then 6 scenarios x [pitch, repDisc, managerDisc]: PLATFORM ONLY, PLATFORM & INSIGHT, PLATFORM & MP, PLATFORM/INSIGHT/MP, PLATFORM & ANALYTICS, PLATFORM/INSIGHT/ANALYTICS
notes: Rows with no NB rate card, no renewal, no insight and no analytics dropped (e.g. ASSOCIATE/STUDENT guides).
Insight upsell/downsell (chosen dep != insightDep) not precomputed: workbook derives it from FY26 CI/CMI spend realisation (excluded data); approximate with the NB insight ladder.
NB rep/manager prices: pitch * (1 - country band disc), see rate-card-tables.json countryBands.
